2116552705887932561.en_summary: tae kim (firstadopter) quotes Fed Chair Kevin Warsh on Oct. 28: AI sector financial conditions tightening. Iran War -> Energy prices -> inflation -> discounting of forward rate policy matters. Warsh skeptical that rate hikes won't affect AI as expected returns differ; interest rates affect almost everything, seen in tech complex since early September with discriminating investments and credit spreads. Quoted own post on financial conditions tightening, $110+ oil, need Iran war resolution to lower energy prices/inflation/rates or risk recession.
2116552705887932561.zh_summary: tae kim (firstadopter)引用聯儲主席Kevin Warsh 10月28日言論：AI板塊金融條件收緊。伊朗戰爭→能源價格→通脹→遠期利率政策折現重要。Warsh懷疑加息不會影響AI，因為預期回報不同；利率幾乎影響一切，自9月初在科技複合體中可見投資歧視和信用利差。引用自己帖文關於金融條件收緊、$110+油價，需要伊朗戰爭可信解決以降低能源價格/通脹/利率，否則風險衰退。

2116549827580551334.en_summary: Robin Brooks replies that it's similar with more recent actions. We only learned the true scale and timing of bond buying for Italy and Spain in 2022 with multiple years' lag. If doing stuff you shouldn't, you'll try to hide it and name-call people who come after you.
2116549827580551334.zh_summary: Robin Brooks回覆說與近期行動類似。我們只在2022年才得知意大利和西班牙債券購買的真實規模和時間，有多年滯後。如果你在做不該做的事，顯然會試圖隱藏並攻擊追查的人。

2116544906638266558.en_summary: Joe Weisenthal (TheStalwart) says he has zero doubt AI is incredibly powerful for coding; every engineer uses it. Not a doubter, but for example wants a project to scan once a day for FOMC member speeches and it's shockingly unreliable.
2116544906638266558.zh_summary: Joe Weisenthal (TheStalwart)表示他毫不懷疑AI對編碼極其強大；每個工程師都在用。不是懷疑者，但例如想讓一個項目每天掃描FOMC成員演講，結果驚人地不可靠。

2116542276738355535.en_summary: Kobeissi Letter: exceptionally volatile earnings season. Information Technology stocks fell -1.2% on average in October on first trading day after reporting, weakest among sectors. Energy and Consumer Staples -0.3% and -0.2%. 8 of 11 sectors positive; Consumer Discretionary +1.9%, Healthcare +1.5%, Industrials +1.2%. Average stock +0.6%. Tech is deviating from the rest of the market.
2116542276738355535.zh_summary: Kobeissi Letter：盈利季節異常波動。資訊科技股在10月報告後第一個交易日平均下跌-1.2%，為所有板塊中最弱。能源和消費必需品分別-0.3%和-0.2%。11個板塊中8個正增長；消費可選+1.9%，醫療保健+1.5%，工業+1.2%。平均股票+0.6%。科技股偏離市場其他部分。

2116539923700285623.en_summary: Andy Constan (dampedspring) shares different view from options dispersion book during tech bubble. Index vol short sizing was a choice; IV/RV premium narrow then unlike today. Drop in implied correlation makes trade less attractive, but risk is buying single name vol too high due to speculative demand and dispersion traders. Responsible CIO would short single name vol if worried, not buy index puts at 20+ vol. Mostly not hedging much.
2116539923700285623.zh_summary: Andy Constan (dampedspring)分享不同觀點，來自科技泡沫期間的分散交易期權經驗。指數波動率做空規模是選擇；當時IV/RV溢價窄，不像今天。隱含相關性下降使交易吸引力降低，但風險是單名波動率買得太高，因投機需求和分散交易者。負責任的CIO如果擔心應做空單名波動率，而不是以20+波動率買指數看跌期權。大多沒有大量對沖。
